SRC-032:R001.text: Add only the exact verified OpenCode built-in skill identity to the bounded adapter read fast-path so bootstrap works without Python or guard reachability.

SRC-032:R002.text: Do not grant skill trust by suffix or namespace; plugin.skill, mcp__x__skill, and every unknown or namespaced identity still enter the guard and fail closed when unreachable.

SRC-032:R003.text: Keep exact built-in repository reads usable without actor binding or guard reachability and retain a red-green regression for the exact skill gap.

SRC-032:R004.text: Provide one canonical production OpenCode launcher that requires an explicit trusted SAIPEN seat and creates SAIPEN_AGENT before OpenCode starts.

SRC-032:R005.text: The canonical launcher exports the resolved project root and portable lineage when present, and all supported OpenCode launch callers reuse this single environment builder.

SRC-032:R006.text: Never use OpenCode sessionID as actor, never inherit STATE.agent for an unbound host launch, and never turn ACTOR_UNBOUND into allow.

SRC-032:R007.text: Capture the launch actor once per OpenCode plugin factory so sequential calls retain one stable seat; independent launches and projects must not leak bindings.

SRC-032:R008.text: Prove Target A through the real supported OpenCode launch path without individual tool cases injecting SAIPEN_AGENT: skill, read, actor presence, admitted source writes, protected write block, unknown consequential block, stable sequence, independent binding, and no GUARD_UNREACHABLE or ACTOR_UNBOUND.

SRC-032:R009.text: Keep a negative control where a genuinely unbound unsupported consequential OpenCode call fails with ACTOR_UNBOUND, and prove a foreign-owner mutation is refused.

SRC-032:R010.text: Do not begin evidence-retention implementation until the real production OpenCode launch path passes Target A.

SRC-032:R011.text: Create bulky runtime HOME, caches, provider profiles, copied repositories, node_modules, build trees, and matrix sandboxes only under an explicitly owned temporary root outside durable .saipen evidence.

SRC-032:R012.text: Retain only bounded proof artifacts such as compact transcripts, verdict JSON, hashes, diffs, byte controls, command and environment metadata, screenshots, non-reproducible artifacts, and a retention manifest.

SRC-032:R013.text: On verified success remove the exact registered run-owned temporary sandbox after proof extraction; on failure or blocked disposition retain compact failure reproduction proof and remove the bulk sandbox too.
